\noindent
The SPELL archive distributed by the \emph{Saccharomyces} Genome Database holds
\spellNStudies{} yeast expression studies, one publication each.
Table~\ref{tab:all} lists every one with its DOI, PubMed and PubMed Central
links and its GEO series. Its first \spellNNewStudies{} rows are the studies
that add a perturbed genotype to the built Kemmeren 2014 and Sameith 2015
datasets, most new genotypes first; the rest follow, most conditions first. Table~\ref{tab:knockout} ranks the
\spellNKoStudies{} studies with a gene deletion in their condition labels by the
number of genes deleted. \spellNNoGeo{} studies name no GEO series, and
Table~\ref{tab:no-geo} lists those separately because their data location has to
be found in the paper.
